title: Insomnia
summary: Calm Vata and mind for restful sleep
ayurvedicView: Sleep issues often relate to excess Vata in the nervous system. Calming routines and grounding practices promote rest.
remedies: Warm foot bath with essential oils
Jatamansi only if a practitioner advises (never with sleeping pills)
tips: Keep your bedroom cool and dark

icd11.title: Insomnia disorders, unspecified
icd11.note: Chronic insomnia is 7A00; short-term insomnia is 7A01.

seeDoctor: Poor sleep for more than three months, or daytime sleepiness that affects driving or work
Loud snoring with pauses in breathing
Low mood, worry or thoughts of self-harm alongside poor sleep
